capabilities: write notes in the SemaLogic formal language
render technical language and graphical views in real time
convert between SemaLogic's natural, technical, and practical language forms
send SemaLogic results to an ASP solving service
include rendered SVG output in PDFs
extras: The README states the API is in early alpha and subject to change, and that the full usage documentation will be published later on SemaLogic.de rather than in the README. Most of the README covers release publishing and local integration testing rather than user-facing usage.
problem: Obsidian has no way to represent or check unambiguous logical relationships written in natural language inside notes.

requires.name: SemaLogic service (service.semalogic.ddns.net or a local/private-network service)

summary: SemaLogic formal-language integration that renders notes as unambiguous logical representations, technical language, and graphics in real time.
